title: Rebellion and Redemption

questions.question: Who received the vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:1 (ESV): "The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem..."

questions.question: Children have I reared and brought up, but they have done what against me?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:2 (ESV): "Children have I reared and brought up, but they have rebelled against me."

questions.question: Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:18 (ESV): "though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow;"

questions.question: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:19 (ESV): "If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;"

questions.question: Zion shall be redeemed by justice, and those in her who repent, by what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:27 (ESV): "Zion shall be redeemed by justice, and those in her who repent, by righteousness."

questions.question: The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master's crib, but who does not know?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:3 (ESV): "The ox knows its owner... but Israel does not know, my people do not understand."

questions.question: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:7 (ESV): "Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire;"

questions.question: Bring no more vain offerings; incense is an abomination to whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:13 (ESV): "incense is an abomination to me. New moon and Sabbath..."

questions.question: Learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression; bring justice to the fatherless, plead the widow's what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:17 (ESV): "bring justice to the fatherless, plead the widow's cause."

questions.question: And the strong one shall become tinder, and his work a spark, and both of them shall burn together, with none to do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:31 (ESV): "and both of them shall burn together, with none to quench them."

questions.question: If the LORD of hosts had not left us a few survivors, we should have been like whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:9 (ESV): "we should have been like Sodom, and become like Gomorrah."

questions.question: Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean; remove the evil of your deeds from before my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:16 (ESV): "remove the evil of your deeds from before my eyes; cease to do evil,"

questions.question: How the faithful city has become a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:21 (ESV): "How the faithful city has become a whore, she who was full of justice!"

questions.question: I will turn my hand against you and will smelt away your dross as with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:25 (ESV): "I will turn my hand against you and will smelt away your dross as with lye"

questions.question: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks that you desired; and you shall blush for the what that you have chosen?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 1:29 (ESV): "and you shall blush for the gardens that you have chosen."

key_verse_text: Come now, let us reason together, says the LORD: though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool.
